This approach amplifies both potential upside and drawdown, and leveraged ETFs are subject to daily decay and rebalancing, requiring strict stop discipline to manage risk.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month, aiming to park cash for yield. It prioritizes income-generating ETFs and broad index exposure, significantly reducing high-beta single names and leverage. While aiming for reliable distributions, these are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff, so it's not a savings account.
